lines.speaker: Guide
lines.text: Oh, hello! You must be new here.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.text: There are stars scattered all over this meadow. Could you bring me five?

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.text: Have you climbed the hill yet? The purple portal will take you there.

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.text: Five stars! You are a natural. Thank you!

lines.speaker: Guide
lines.text: Still looking? They glow, so keep your eyes open!
